name: token-monitor
description: Live token & cost widget for Claude Code, Codex & Hermes — local-first, optional multi-device sync.

scripts.pack:mac:widget: TOKEN_MONITOR_WIDGET_ENABLED=1 TOKEN_MONITOR_LOCAL_DEVELOPMENT_SIGNING=1 npm run build:mac-widget && TOKEN_MONITOR_WIDGET_ENABLED=1 TOKEN_MONITOR_LOCAL_DEVELOPMENT_SIGNING=1 node scripts/macos-packaging.js && TOKEN_MONITOR_WIDGET_ENABLED=1 TOKEN_MONITOR_LOCAL_DEVELOPMENT_SIGNING=1 electron-builder --config scripts/electron-builder.config.js --dir
scripts.pack:mac:widget:x64: TOKEN_MONITOR_WIDGET_ENABLED=1 TOKEN_MONITOR_WIDGET_ARCH=x64 TOKEN_MONITOR_LOCAL_DEVELOPMENT_SIGNING=1 npm run build:mac-widget && TOKEN_MONITOR_WIDGET_ENABLED=1 TOKEN_MONITOR_WIDGET_ARCH=x64 TOKEN_MONITOR_LOCAL_DEVELOPMENT_SIGNING=1 node scripts/macos-packaging.js && TOKEN_MONITOR_WIDGET_ENABLED=1 TOKEN_MONITOR_WIDGET_ARCH=x64 TOKEN_MONITOR_LOCAL_DEVELOPMENT_SIGNING=1 electron-builder --config scripts/electron-builder.config.js --mac --x64 --dir --config.directories.output=dist/mac-x64
scripts.dist:mac:widget: TOKEN_MONITOR_WIDGET_ENABLED=1 TOKEN_MONITOR_WIDGET_DISTRIBUTION=1 TOKEN_MONITOR_WIDGET_ARCH=arm64 npm run build:mac-widget && TOKEN_MONITOR_WIDGET_ENABLED=1 TOKEN_MONITOR_WIDGET_DISTRIBUTION=1 TOKEN_MONITOR_WIDGET_ARCH=arm64 node scripts/macos-packaging.js && TOKEN_MONITOR_WIDGET_ENABLED=1 TOKEN_MONITOR_WIDGET_DISTRIBUTION=1 TOKEN_MONITOR_WIDGET_ARCH=arm64 electron-builder --config scripts/electron-builder.config.js --mac --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac:widget:x64: TOKEN_MONITOR_WIDGET_ENABLED=1 TOKEN_MONITOR_WIDGET_DISTRIBUTION=1 TOKEN_MONITOR_WIDGET_ARCH=x64 npm run build:mac-widget && TOKEN_MONITOR_WIDGET_ENABLED=1 TOKEN_MONITOR_WIDGET_DISTRIBUTION=1 TOKEN_MONITOR_WIDGET_ARCH=x64 node scripts/macos-packaging.js && TOKEN_MONITOR_WIDGET_ENABLED=1 TOKEN_MONITOR_WIDGET_DISTRIBUTION=1 TOKEN_MONITOR_WIDGET_ARCH=x64 electron-builder --config scripts/electron-builder.config.js --mac --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win:prepackaged: electron-builder --config scripts/electron-builder.config.js --prepackaged dist/win-unpacked --win nsis portable --x64 --publish never
